settings.heading: THE WORLD STARTED WITH LIMITATIONS.
settings.bio:
Rizo began without a blueprint, deep resources, or a clear path. Taymar Spencer learned through the work—designing and making the clothes himself, accepting help, and turning every limitation into part of the language.

What began as one person’s outlet became a way to give other people room to express themselves. Rizo exists to give creativity somewhere to live—and to prove that being placed in a box does not mean staying there.

settings.quote: Rizo started through limitations. I was in a box, and I broke out.

settings.heading: KNOW WHAT ENTERS THE WORLD NEXT.
settings.value: Drop dates, Pittsburgh event locations, and restock notices—only when there is something real to send.

settings.heading: THE WORLD NEVER MOVED ALONE.
settings.text:
Rizo is founder-led, but friends, models, event help, supporters, and people who believed early helped carry it outside.

No fake corporate titles. Just real people showing up while the world takes shape.
settings.shoutout: SHOUT OUT TO EVERY PERSON WHO MODELED, HELPED AT A TABLE, CARRIED PIECES, TOOK A PHOTO, GAVE FEEDBACK, OR SHOWED UP BEFORE THERE WAS A TITLE FOR IT.
